question.text: A solid sphere of mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi></math> is making pure rolling on a horizontal surface with kinetic energy <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2240</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi></math>. The velocity of centre of mass of the sphere will be ______ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>.

solution.text:
Let velocity of centre of mass of sphere be v.

Total kinetic energy of solid sphere is KE=12mv2+12Iω2, where, I is moment of inertia of the solid sphere about the axis passing through it's centre of mass and ω=vR pure rolling condition.

Therefore,

 2240=122(v)2+1225(2)R2vR2

⇒2240=v2+25v2

⇒v=40 m s-1.
